projectTitle: Capture: detecting and inhibiting Pseudomonas aeruginosa quorum-sensing signals
projectTitle_zh: Capture：偵測並抑制 Pseudomonas aeruginosa 的群體感應訊號
tagline: A US$54 to US$161 single-cuvette fluorescence reader, and a browser app that turns its counts into an AHL concentration with a 95% confidence interval.
tagline_zh: 一台造價 54 至 161 美元的單樣品槽螢光判讀儀，以及一個瀏覽器應用程式，可把它的計數值換算成帶 95% 信賴區間的 AHL 濃度。
summary: NCKU-Tainan targeted the acyl-homoserine lactone signals that Pseudomonas aeruginosa uses to coordinate toxin release and biofilm formation in healthcare-associated infections, with two systems reading the same molecule: one that detects the signal and reports the infection, and one that inhibits it with published single-stranded DNA aptamers acting as molecular sponges. To read their GFP reporter without booking a shared plate reader in another building they built CAPTURE-Screen, a single-cuvette fluorescence reader in two versions, 3D-printed and laser-cut, costing 21 to 65 times less than an open-source plate reader. LasReader, a browser application, completes the chain by fitting a weighted four-parameter logistic calibration, deriving limits of detection from the blanks and returning each sample's concentration with an approximate confidence interval.
summary_zh: NCKU-Tainan 針對 Pseudomonas aeruginosa 在醫療照護相關感染中用來協調毒素釋放與生物膜形成的醯基高絲胺酸內酯訊號，做了兩套讀取同一個分子的系統：一套偵測訊號並通報感染，另一套則以已發表的單股 DNA 適體作為分子海綿來抑制它。為了讀取自己的 GFP 報告訊號又不必到另一棟樓預約共用的微量盤判讀儀，他們做了 CAPTURE-Screen，一台單樣品槽螢光判讀儀，有 3D 列印與雷射切割兩個版本，成本比開源微量盤判讀儀低 21 至 65 倍。瀏覽器應用程式 LasReader 補完了整條鏈：擬合加權的四參數邏輯斯校正曲線，由空白樣本推導偵測極限，並回傳每個樣品的濃度與近似信賴區間。

dry.frameworks: The hardware page opens by deriving its requirements from the assay rather than from an instrument wish list: 200 uL of sfGFP culture per reaction, read every hour for six hours at 37 C, benchmarked against the plate-reader standard of 485/510 nm, and cheap enough to rebuild. The modelling is split into three parts that each serve a different part of the team (an inhibition model for the wet lab, an imaging model for the software, a fluorescence model for the hardware). Software, hardware and model are written as one workflow, with LasReader checking the reader, showing which tube to read next, and keeping every saved curve with its limit of detection and usable range.
dry.frameworks_zh: 硬體頁面一開頭就從檢測需求而非儀器願望清單推導規格：每次反應 200 uL 的 sfGFP 培養液、在 37 C 下每小時讀一次共六小時、以微量盤判讀儀的 485/510 nm 標準作為對標，而且便宜到可以重做一台。建模被拆成三個部分，各自服務團隊的不同組別（給濕實驗的抑制模型、給軟體的成像模型、給硬體的螢光模型）。軟體、硬體與模型寫成同一條工作流程：LasReader 會檢查判讀儀狀態、顯示下一支該讀哪一管，並把每一條存下的曲線連同其偵測極限與可用範圍一併保留。
dry.dataviz: Plan-view and cut-away optical diagrams drawn to scale with a stated pixel-to-millimetre ratio; an interactive exploded view of the instrument; counts-versus-condition plots that always show the emission channel beside the scatter channel; a calibration page in the app that renders the fitted curve as a PNG alongside the CSV export; a step bar at the top of every CAPTURE-Screen page showing the reader status, the number of calibration runs, how many produced a usable curve, and whether Measure is ready.
dry.dataviz_zh: 依比例繪製並標明像素對毫米比例的俯視圖與剖面光學圖；可互動的儀器爆炸圖；計數值對條件的圖表，而且總是把放射通道與散射通道並列呈現；應用程式中的校正頁面會把擬合曲線輸出為 PNG，同時提供 CSV 匯出；每一個 CAPTURE-Screen 頁面頂端都有一條步驟列，顯示判讀儀狀態、校正執行次數、其中有幾次產生可用曲線，以及 Measure 是否就緒。
dry.datascience: The instrument is honest about what its numbers are. Readings are raw sensor counts from an AS7341 ten-channel spectral sensor, with F4 (515 nm) as the emission channel and F3 (480 nm) reported beside it as the scatter channel, because the team found that dense suspensions give a few counts of F4 with no reporter present once F3 passes about 46 and none below about 33, so a few counts alone are not evidence of GFP. Excitation and emission are separated by angle (detection at 90 degrees) and by colour (the sensor's own bands), with no emission filter, and a light trap whose end wall slopes at about 41 degrees turns transmitted blue up into the roof rather than back at the sample. Every measurement cycle begins and ends with a dark read, and under the shield every channel must read exactly zero or the cycle is void. Repeatability is quantified at the level that actually varies: five re-insertions of one tube gave 0.76% standard deviation at about 50 counts. Validation is comparative rather than self-referential, with one batch of sfGFP culture at five dilutions plus medium and a non-fluorescent culture read on the team's reader and on a SpectraMax M3 on the same day, ranking the tubes the same way, with the green reading rising from 2.44 to 86.44 counts and about 104 counts per unit OD600 across the three denser tubes. The team states plainly that counts from the two readers are not interchangeable, and reports the failures: the laser-cut build could not distinguish the AHL sensor strain from cells without sfGFP, and the 3D-printed build read zero on its emission channel for that strain. LasReader carries the statistics. It requires at least four concentrations and two blanks as the minimum for a four-parameter curve and a limit of detection, and fits a weighted four-parameter logistic in which EC50 is fitted as its logarithm to keep it positive and the Hill slope is bounded between 0.05 and 20, with blanks entering at zero concentration so they fix the baseline directly. Weighting is used because replicates scatter more at high signal than at low, and the uncertainty of the fitted curve is propagated through the Jacobian of the model derivatives with a diagonal weight matrix, which is what produces the approximate 95% confidence interval on every reported concentration. Detection limits follow the blank-based convention, LOD as the inverse curve evaluated at the blank mean plus three blank standard deviations and LOQ at ten, with documented fallbacks when every blank reads identically, and the usable range starting at whichever is higher, the LOD or the lowest standard, so that a sample can clear the LOD and still be reported as below the usable range. Exports are auditable: one CSV with every reading, every exclusion and its reason, and every result, plus the curve as a PNG, with a curve's own exclusions kept with the curve in its JSON backup. The mechanistic modelling matches this care, with two parameters fitted to swarming data and uncertainty assessed by 400 joint draws combining plate-level bootstrap resampling with uncertain model inputs and refitting each time (296 successful), reporting 5th to 95th percentile ranges, PRCC sensitivity indices, and the explicit statement that these are effective values and not confidence intervals for measured biochemical constants.
dry.datascience_zh: 這台儀器對自己的數字很誠實。讀值是來自 AS7341 十通道光譜感測器的原始計數，以 F4（515 nm）作為放射通道，並把 F3（480 nm）作為散射通道並列報告，因為團隊發現在沒有報告蛋白時，濃密的菌懸液一旦 F3 超過約 46 就會給出幾個計數的 F4，而低於約 33 則完全沒有，所以單憑幾個計數並不能作為 GFP 的證據。激發與放射以角度（在 90 度偵測）與顏色（感測器自身的頻段）分開，沒有放射濾光片；一個末端牆面傾斜約 41 度的光陷阱會把穿透的藍光往上導向頂部，而不是反射回樣品。每一個量測週期的開始與結束都做一次暗讀值，在遮罩之下每一個通道都必須讀到恰好為零，否則該週期作廢。重複性是在真正會變動的層次上被量化：同一管重新插入五次，在約 50 個計數處得到 0.76% 的標準差。驗證採比較式而非自我參照：同一批 sfGFP 培養液的五個稀釋度，加上培養基與一組不發螢光的培養液，在同一天分別以團隊的判讀儀與一台 SpectraMax M3 量測，兩者對各管的排序一致，綠色讀值從 2.44 上升到 86.44 個計數，在較濃的三管中約為每單位 OD600 104 個計數。團隊直白表示兩台判讀儀的計數並不可互換，也報告了失敗：雷射切割版本無法區分 AHL 感測菌株與不含 sfGFP 的細胞，而 3D 列印版本對該菌株的放射通道讀到零。統計則由 LasReader 承擔。它要求至少四個濃度與兩個空白樣本，作為四參數曲線與偵測極限的最低條件，並擬合加權的四參數邏輯斯模型，其中 EC50 以對數形式擬合以保持為正值，Hill 斜率被限制在 0.05 與 20 之間，而空白樣本以濃度為零進入擬合，因此直接固定了基線。採用加權是因為重複樣本在高訊號處的分散程度大於低訊號處；擬合曲線的不確定性則透過模型導數的 Jacobian 矩陣搭配對角權重矩陣傳遞，這正是每一個報告濃度上那個近似 95% 信賴區間的來源。偵測極限遵循以空白為基礎的慣例：LOD 為反函數曲線在空白平均值加三倍空白標準差處的取值，LOQ 則取十倍，並對所有空白讀值完全相同的情況記錄了備援做法；可用範圍則從 LOD 與最低標準品之中較高者開始，因此一個樣品可能通過 LOD，卻仍被報告為低於可用範圍。匯出內容可供稽核：一份 CSV 包含每一筆讀值、每一次排除及其理由，以及每一項結果，另加曲線的 PNG，而某條曲線自身的排除紀錄會與該曲線一起保存在它的 JSON 備份中。機制性建模也維持同樣的謹慎：兩個參數以群游資料擬合，不確定性以 400 次聯合抽樣評估，做法是把盤層級的 bootstrap 重抽與不確定的模型輸入結合，每次都重新擬合（其中 296 次成功），並報告第 5 到第 95 百分位區間、PRCC 敏感度指標，同時明確聲明這些是有效值，而不是所測生化常數的信賴區間。
dry.software: LasReader, a browser application with nothing to install, released under the MIT License with source on iGEM GitLab, carrying a research-use-only disclaimer that it reports concentrations inferred from a calibration curve and is not intended for diagnostic use. It works either with CAPTURE-Screen, where the instrument becomes part of the workflow, or with data from any plate reader through the same steps, and the analysis never uses the target's name so it transfers to other biosensors whose rising response suits a 4PL fit. The hardware is released as 53 STL files covering 66 pieces across both versions, with firmware that controls LED timing and integration, plus the laser-cut design, wiring and schematic.
dry.software_zh: LasReader 是一個不需安裝任何東西的瀏覽器應用程式，以 MIT License 釋出，原始碼放在 iGEM GitLab，並帶有僅供研究使用的免責聲明，說明它所報告的濃度是由校正曲線推得，不供診斷用途。它既可與 CAPTURE-Screen 搭配，使儀器成為工作流程的一部分，也能以相同步驟處理任何微量盤判讀儀的資料；而分析過程從未用到標的物的名稱，因此可以移轉到其他反應隨濃度上升、適合 4PL 擬合的生物感測器上。硬體以 53 個 STL 檔釋出，涵蓋兩個版本共 66 個零件，並附上控制 LED 時序與積分時間的韌體，以及雷射切割設計圖、配線與電路圖。
stack: Bootstrap resampling and PRCC sensitivity analysis
techniques: Dark read at the start and end of every cycle, voided if non-zero
Scatter channel reported alongside the emission channel
Re-insertion repeatability as a stated percentage
Side-by-side benchmarking against a commercial plate reader
Weighted 4PL calibration with bounded Hill slope
Confidence intervals propagated through the fit Jacobian
Blank-derived LOD and LOQ with documented fallbacks
Usable range set by the higher of LOD and lowest standard
Auditable CSV export of every exclusion and its reason

good.publicEngagement: Education work includes a board game and an online game alongside a documented education programme, a promotion page and a survey.
good.publicEngagement_zh: 教育工作包括一款桌遊與一款線上遊戲，另有一份有記錄的教育計畫、一個推廣頁面與一份問卷調查。
good.ihp: A meet-with-experts programme fed the project's scope and its claims. Prof. Nan-Si Li's framing, that at this stage the project detects signals and does not diagnose infections, is quoted directly in the software's own disclaimer, so the limit on the claim is visible inside the tool rather than only on the wiki.
good.ihp_zh: 一個與專家會面的計畫餵養了專案的範圍與其主張。Prof. Nan-Si Li 的定調，也就是現階段這個專案偵測的是訊號、並不診斷感染，被直接引述在軟體自己的免責聲明裡，因此主張的界線就顯示在工具內部，而不只是寫在 wiki 上。
good.realWorld: The problem is framed around healthcare-associated infections, where P. aeruginosa resists many antibiotics, releases tissue-damaging toxins and forms biofilms that antibiotics struggle to cross, all behaviours that depend on cells coordinating through chemical signals. The instrument's justification is operational: a shared plate reader is booked, scheduled and in one building, while either build can sit next to the incubator. Cost is given against a named alternative, at most US$161 for the 3D-printed build and US$54 for the laser-cut one versus under US$3,500 for a published open-source plate reader, with the point that anyone with the source files can rebuild it. The reader is positioned for the commonest reading in synthetic biology, green fluorescence from a GFP reporter in a liquid sample, and for cell-free portable sensors that hold no cells at all.
good.realWorld_zh: 問題框定在醫療照護相關感染上：P. aeruginosa 對許多抗生素具抗性，會釋出破壞組織的毒素，並形成抗生素難以穿透的生物膜，而這些行為全都依賴細胞透過化學訊號彼此協調。儀器的理由是操作層面的：共用的微量盤判讀儀要預約、要排程，而且在另一棟樓裡，而這兩個版本都可以就放在培養箱旁邊。成本是對著一個具名的替代方案給出的：3D 列印版本最多 161 美元、雷射切割版本 54 美元，相對於一台已發表的開源微量盤判讀儀不到 3,500 美元；重點在於任何人只要有原始檔案就能重做一台。這台判讀儀的定位是合成生物學中最常見的讀值，也就是液體樣品中 GFP 報告蛋白的綠色螢光，以及完全不含細胞的無細胞可攜式感測器。

images.caption: CAPTURE-Screen, the team's single-cuvette fluorescence reader for GFP reporter cultures, built so it can sit next to the incubator instead of competing for a shared plate reader in another building.
images.caption_zh: CAPTURE-Screen，團隊為 GFP 報告菌培養液打造的單樣品槽螢光判讀儀，設計上可以就放在培養箱旁邊，不必去搶另一棟樓裡的共用微量盤判讀儀。

images.caption_zh: 一支 200 uL 的 UVette 裝入 3D 列印版本。激發光從側面進入，AS7341 偵測器在 90 度讀取，沒有放射濾光片；顏色的分離來自感測器本身。

images.caption: The laser-cut version of the reader in its own enclosure, costed at US$54 against under US$3,500 for the open-source plate reader the team benchmarked against.
images.caption_zh: 雷射切割版本的判讀儀與其外殼，成本計為 54 美元，對比團隊所對標的開源微量盤判讀儀不到 3,500 美元。

images.caption: LasReader's calibration view. A weighted four-parameter logistic curve is fitted with the blanks fixing the baseline, limits of detection and quantification are derived from the blanks, and each sample inside the usable range is returned with an approximate 95% confidence interval.
images.caption_zh: LasReader 的校正畫面。加權四參數邏輯斯曲線以空白樣本固定基線進行擬合，偵測極限與定量極限由空白樣本推導，而落在可用範圍內的每個樣品都會附上近似 95% 信賴區間回傳。

gemsTakeaway: Ship the analysis with the instrument: a calibration that fits a weighted 4PL, derives its detection limit from the blanks, propagates a confidence interval onto every reported concentration, and exports every excluded reading with its reason turns a cheap reader's raw counts into a number someone else can audit.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 把分析與儀器一起出貨：一套會擬合加權 4PL、由空白樣本推導偵測極限、把信賴區間傳遞到每一個報告濃度上，並把每一筆被排除的讀值連同排除理由一起匯出的分析流程，能把一台便宜判讀儀的原始計數值，變成別人可以稽核的數字。
